privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: 9 March 2026. Effective immediately upon publication.

sections.title: 1. Introduction & Identity of the Controller
paragraphs: mAI prop is a real estate technology platform operated by Data Estate PC, a company incorporated in Greece and registered with the Hellenic Companies Register (GEMI). We act as data controller under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 2016/679 and Greek Law 4624/2019.
Controller: Data Estate PC, Akadimias 32, 106 72, Athens, Greece.

sections.title: 2. Scope of This Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy applies to personal data collected through the mAI prop website, mobile applications, APIs, embedded widgets, third-party services we operate, and offline interactions such as property viewings, phone consultations, or support. It does not apply to third-party websites linked from our platform.
list: The mAI prop website and platform services.
Mobile applications for iOS and Android, where applicable.
API integrations, embedded widgets, marketplace tools, and platform services.
Offline interactions with our staff, partners, or agents.

sections.title: 3. Categories of Personal Data We Collect
paragraphs: We collect different categories of data depending on how you use the platform. We do not intentionally collect special category data such as health, biometric, racial, political, or sexual orientation data.

rows: Listings, offer requests, auction alerts, Quick Sale applications
Pages visited, filters, IP address, browser, device, time zone
Billing name and card metadata handled by Stripe

sections.title: 4. Legal Bases for Processing
paragraphs: We process personal data only where a lawful basis applies under GDPR Article 6.
list: Performance of a contract: account management, listing services, viewing scheduling, messaging, and paid services.
Legitimate interests: fraud prevention, platform security, analytics, service improvement, and direct marketing to existing customers with opt-out.
Legal obligation: tax, accounting, AML/KYC, court orders, and other Greek or EU legal requirements.
Consent: optional marketing, non-essential cookies, and optional AI personalisation features.
Vital interests: emergencies where protection of life or safety is required.

sections.title: 5. How We Use Your Data
paragraphs: We use personal data to operate and improve the platform and to comply with applicable obligations. We do not sell personal data to third parties for their own marketing purposes.
list: Create and manage accounts, verify identity, and prevent duplicate or fraudulent accounts.
Display, manage, and promote property listings and project showcases.
Facilitate viewings, Open House workflows, auction alerts, Quick Sale offers, and consultations.
Power AI search, property valuation, neighbourhood reports, and smart filters.
Process payments, send transactional notifications, respond to support, and resolve disputes.
Detect fraud, abuse, security incidents, and enforce our Terms of Service.

sections.title: 6. Data Sharing & Third-Party Recipients
paragraphs: We share data only where needed to provide the service, comply with law, or protect users and the platform.
list: Service providers such as infrastructure, email, payment, analytics, AI, and mapping vendors under GDPR-compliant data processing terms.
Other platform users where needed for listings, messages, viewings, offers, and professional directory profiles.
Greek authorities, courts, tax bodies, law enforcement, and regulators where legally required.
Business transfer recipients in connection with a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or sale of assets, with notice where required.
Aggregated or anonymised market statistics that cannot identify you.

sections.title: 7. International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Data is primarily stored and processed in the European Economic Area. Where transfers outside the EEA occur, we use appropriate safeguards such as EU Standard Contractual Clauses, adequacy decisions, and data minimisation. You may request details through the contact form or by post at Data Estate PC, Akadimias 32, 106 72, Athens, Greece.

sections.title: 8. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purpose collected or as required by law.
list: Account data: for the account lifetime and up to 5 years after closure where tax or AML duties apply.
Listing and transaction data: up to 7 years after a transaction or relevant activity.
Messages and communications: normally 3 years unless a dispute requires longer retention.
Usage and analytics data: up to 26 months in identifiable form, then anonymised.
Payment records: up to 10 years under accounting and VAT requirements.
AI interaction logs: up to 90 days in identifiable form for safety and abuse monitoring, then anonymised.

sections.title: 9. Your Rights Under GDPR
paragraphs: You may exercise your rights free of charge through the contact form or by post at Data Estate PC, Akadimias 32, 106 72, Athens, Greece. We respond to verified requests within 30 calendar days, extendable to 90 days for complex requests with notice.
list: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection.
Withdrawal of consent where processing is based on consent.
Objection to direct marketing at any time.
Human review of AI-assisted recommendations where relevant.
Complaint to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority at www.dpa.gr.

sections.title: 10. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar technologies as described in our Cookie Policy. You can manage preferences through the consent banner or browser settings. Declining non-essential cookies does not affect core platform access.

sections.title: 11. AI & Machine Learning
paragraphs: mAI prop uses AI for property valuation, search, neighbourhood analysis, filters, chat assistance, and investment analytics. These systems support human decisions and may contain errors.
list: Models use aggregated and anonymised real estate data where possible.
Search queries and interaction data may be used in anonymised or pseudonymised form to improve performance.
AI tools do not make legally significant decisions about you without human oversight.
You may opt out of optional AI personalisation by contacting us.

sections.title: 12. Security
paragraphs: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures including TLS encryption, access controls, staff MFA, vulnerability assessments, infrastructure safeguards, and incident response procedures. No system is completely secure. If you suspect unauthorised access, use the contact form or write to Data Estate PC, Akadimias 32, 106 72, Athens, Greece immediately.

sections.title: 13. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The platform is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If we become aware that such data was collected without appropriate consent, we will delete it promptly.

sections.title: 14. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified by email or prominent platform notice at least 30 days before taking effect where required. Continued use after the effective date means acceptance of the revised Policy.

If you do not agree, you must stop using the platform. If you use the platform for a business, you confirm that you can bind that business to these Terms.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old and legally capable under Greek law to use the platform.
list: Your registration information must be accurate and current.
Your use must comply with applicable law.
You must not be subject to sanctions that prohibit transactions on the platform.

sections.title: 3. Account Registration & Security
paragraphs: Some features require an account. You are responsible for your credentials and all activity under your account. Use the contact form immediately if you suspect unauthorised access. You may not share accounts, create duplicate accounts to bypass limits, or circumvent suspensions.

sections.title: 4. Platform Services
paragraphs: mAI prop is a technology intermediary, not a real estate agent, broker, auctioneer, or financial advisor. We do not act as a party to property transactions and do not verify legal title, planning status, or property condition.
list: Property listings for sale or rent.
Greek auction listing aggregation and alerts.
Quick Sale preliminary offers and AI-assisted valuation workflows.
Professional directory and marketplace services.
AI tools for search, valuation, neighbourhood reports, and analytics.
Messaging between users and professionals.

sections.title: 5. Listing Standards & Prohibited Content
paragraphs: Listings and submitted content must be accurate, lawful, and connected to a real property that the lister owns, is authorised to market, or has been engaged to list.
list: No fraudulent, fictitious, duplicate, discriminatory, defamatory, obscene, threatening, or unlawful content.
No undisclosed encumbrances, disputes, or misleading property information intended to deceive buyers.
No phishing, scraping, data harvesting, or infringement of third-party rights.
We may remove non-compliant listings at our discretion without prior notice.

sections.title: 6. AI-Generated Content & Valuations
paragraphs: AI outputs are for informational and indicative purposes only. They are not professional valuations, legal advice, financial advice, tax advice, investment advice, or binding offers. You should independently verify information and seek professional advice before acting.

sections.title: 7. Greek Auctions - Special Provisions
paragraphs: Auction information is aggregated from public sources and may be incomplete or outdated. mAI prop is not an e-auction platform and does not facilitate actual bidding.
list: Participation in Greek judicial auctions is subject to specific legal requirements.
You are responsible for due diligence, legal advice, and checking title, encumbrances, possession, and disputes.
Auction properties may carry risks including encumbrances, occupancy issues, or pending proceedings.

sections.title: 8. Fees & Payments
paragraphs: Some features are paid, including premium listing packages, subscriptions, and Quick Sale services. Fees are displayed in Euros, include applicable Greek VAT where stated, and are processed through Stripe. Fees are non-refundable unless required by law or expressly stated. Use the contact form within 30 days if you believe a charge is incorrect.

sections.title: 9. Intellectual Property
paragraphs: Platform content, branding, software, databases, AI models, design, text, and aggregated market data belong to Data Estate PC or its licensors. By submitting listings, photos, or content, you grant mAI prop a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to display, reproduce, adapt, and distribute that content on the platform and in marketing for as long as reasonably needed.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.updated: Last updated: 9 March 2026. This policy explains how mAI prop uses cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They help recognise your device, remember preferences, and provide features. Cookies may be session cookies deleted when you close your browser or persistent cookies stored until expiry or deletion.
We also use similar technologies such as web beacons, pixel tags, local storage, session storage, and privacy-respecting analytics scripts. We refer to all of these as cookies in this Policy.

sections.title: 2. Legal Framework
paragraphs: Our cookie practices comply with the EU ePrivacy Directive as implemented in Greece, GDPR, Hellenic Data Protection Authority guidance, and applicable EU case law. We require explicit opt-in consent before setting non-strictly-necessary cookies. You may withdraw consent at any time.

subsections.title: 3.1 Strictly Necessary Cookies
paragraphs: These are essential for the platform to work and cannot be disabled.

rows: Supabase authentication session token that keeps you logged in
Stores light or dark theme preference

subsections.title: 3.2 Functional Cookies
paragraphs: These improve experience and are enabled only with your consent.

rows: Stores recent searches for quick access
Stores map view, zoom, and layers

subsections.title: 3.3 Analytics Cookies
paragraphs: These help us understand platform usage and improve features. They are enabled only with consent.

rows: Product analytics, page views, feature usage, funnels
Event tracking for platform improvements with IP anonymisation
Optional UX research recordings and heatmaps when opted in

subsections.title: 3.4 Mapping Cookies
paragraphs: Interactive maps use Mapbox. Mapbox may set cookies to optimise tile loading and map performance when you interact with map features.

rows: Map tile caching and interaction telemetry for map performance

subsections.title: 3.5 Marketing & Retargeting Cookies
paragraphs: We do not currently use third-party advertising or retargeting cookies. If introduced later, this Policy will be updated and consent will be requested before such cookies are set.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Embeds
paragraphs: Some pages may embed external websites or services. Embedded services may set their own cookies under their own policies. We do not control cookies set by third-party iframes.

sections.title: 5. How to Manage Your Cookie Preferences
paragraphs: You can manage cookies through our consent banner, footer Cookie Settings link, or browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may prevent the platform from working correctly. Browser help is available from Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, and Microsoft Edge support pages.

sections.title: 6. Do Not Track
paragraphs: Some browsers transmit Do Not Track signals. We honour those signals where technically feasible by not setting analytics or functional cookies without explicit banner consent. Strictly necessary cookies are exempt.

sections.title: 7. Cookie Consent Records
paragraphs: We keep a record of consent choices, including what you consented to, when, and the policy version in effect. Records are retained for 1 year after the last consent interaction. You can request a copy through the contact form or by post at Data Estate PC, Akadimias 32, 106 72, Athens, Greece.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We update this Policy when cookies are added, removed, or changed. Material changes will be communicated through the consent banner and renewed consent will be requested where required.

paragraphs: For questions about cookies or rights requests, use the contact form or write to Data Estate PC, Akadimias 32, 106 72, Athens, Greece. To lodge a complaint, contact the Hellenic Data Protection Authority at www.dpa.gr.
